audio.t: Hello, I'm calling from Westside Dental Clinic. We ordered two hundred boxes of disposable gloves last week, but we only received one hundred and fifty.
Let me check your order. Yes, the last fifty boxes were placed on back order because our warehouse ran out. They should ship on Monday.
Monday's fine, but we were charged for all two hundred boxes.
You're right, that's our mistake. I'll refund the difference now, and you'll be charged again when the remaining boxes ship.

questions.prompt: Where does the woman most likely work?
questions.evidence: I'm calling from Westside Dental Clinic.
questions.explanation: Elle appelle de la part de la clinique dentaire Westside.
questions.takeaway: La 1re réplique donne souvent l'identité de l'appelant.

questions.prompt: Why was part of the order not delivered?
options: It was sent to the wrong address.
Some items were temporarily out of stock.
questions.evidence: placed on back order because our warehouse ran out
questions.explanation: L'entrepôt était en rupture : les 50 boîtes restantes sont en commande différée.
questions.takeaway: Back order = commande en attente de réapprovisionnement.

questions.prompt: What will the man do now?
options: Send the remaining boxes by express mail
questions.evidence: I'll refund the difference now
questions.explanation: Il rembourse immédiatement la différence facturée à tort.
questions.takeaway: Refund the difference = rembourser la différence.

sets.title: Inscription à une salle de sport

audio.t: Hi, I'd like some information about memberships. My company recently moved into the building across the street.
Welcome! Actually, we have a corporate agreement with several companies nearby. Which company do you work for?
Dalton Engineering.
Then you're eligible for our corporate rate, which is twenty-five percent off. You'll just need to show your employee ID card when you sign up.

questions.prompt: What is the man asking about?
questions.evidence: I'd like some information about memberships.
questions.explanation: Il se renseigne sur les abonnements d'une salle de sport.

questions.prompt: What does the woman say about Dalton Engineering employees?
options: They have exclusive access to some classes.
They can use the gym for free.
They must sign a one-year contract.
questions.evidence: you're eligible for our corporate rate, which is twenty-five percent off
questions.explanation: Les employés bénéficient du tarif entreprise, 25 % moins cher.

questions.prompt: What will the man need to show?
questions.evidence: show your employee ID card when you sign up
questions.explanation: Il doit présenter sa carte d'employé lors de l'inscription.
questions.takeaway: ID card = carte d'identité / de badge.

audio.t: Priya, Carla, are we still on track to launch the new website on the first?
The design is finished, but the product descriptions still need to be translated into German and Italian.
The translation agency promised them by the twenty-fifth. That leaves us almost a week for testing.
Good. Priya, can you set up a test session with a few customers so we get some outside feedback?
Sure, I'll invite some of our regular buyers.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers discussing?
questions.evidence: are we still on track to launch the new website on the first?
questions.explanation: Ils font le point sur le lancement du nouveau site web.

questions.prompt: What still needs to be done?
questions.evidence: the product descriptions still need to be translated into German and Italian
questions.explanation: Les descriptions des produits doivent encore être traduites.

questions.prompt: What will Priya do?
options: Invite customers to test the website
questions.evidence: I'll invite some of our regular buyers.
questions.explanation: Elle invitera des clients habituels à une séance de test.

audio.t: I'm booking your flight to Barcelona for Tuesday. The client meeting there starts at two.
I'd rather not take the early morning flight; I have a call with the Tokyo office until eight.
OK. The airport is about thirty minutes from the client's office, so you'd need to land by one at the latest.
Then book the only flight that works, even if it's the most expensive. And please reserve a taxi from the airport.

questions.prompt: Why can't the man take the early flight?
options: He lives far from the airport.
questions.evidence: I have a call with the Tokyo office until eight
questions.explanation: Il a un appel avec le bureau de Tokyo jusqu'à 8 h.
questions.takeaway: I'd rather not = je préférerais ne pas.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which flight will the woman book?
questions.explanation: Il faut partir après 8 h et atterrir avant 13 h : seul le VL 205 (arrivée 11 h 05) convient, même s'il est le plus cher.
questions.traps: AE 318 arrive à 13 h 45, trop tard ; VL 201 part trop tôt.
questions.takeaway: Applique chaque contrainte (départ et arrivée) au tableau.

questions.prompt: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.evidence: please reserve a taxi from the airport
questions.explanation: Il demande de réserver un taxi depuis l'aéroport : un transport terrestre.

audio.t: Alice, I read your draft of the market analysis. It's very thorough.
Thanks. Was there anything you'd like me to change?
Well, it's forty pages long, and the directors will only have ten minutes to look at it before the meeting.
I see. I'll write a one-page summary of the main findings and put it at the beginning.

questions.prompt: What did the woman write?
questions.evidence: your draft of the market analysis
questions.explanation: L'homme a lu le brouillon de l'analyse de marché rédigée par Alice.

questions.prompt: Why does the man say, "the directors will only have ten minutes to look at it"?
options: To ask her to present it herself
To suggest that the report is too long
questions.evidence: the directors will only have ten minutes to look at it before the meeting
questions.explanation: 40 pages pour 10 minutes de lecture : il suggère que le document est trop long. Elle propose donc un résumé d'une page.
questions.takeaway: Une contrainte mentionnée sert souvent de critique implicite.

questions.prompt: What will the woman do?
options: Shorten the analysis to ten pages
questions.evidence: I'll write a one-page summary of the main findings
questions.explanation: Elle ajoutera un résumé d'une page au début du rapport.

audio.t: Hi, this is Ruth on the fourth floor. The heating in our meeting rooms hasn't worked since this morning.
Sorry about that. A pipe broke in the basement overnight, and the plumber is working on it now.
We have clients coming at three. Will it be fixed by then?
Probably not. But the meeting rooms on the second floor are on a separate system. Room 2B is free this afternoon if you'd like me to reserve it for you.

questions.prompt: What problem does the woman report?
questions.evidence: The heating in our meeting rooms hasn't worked since this morning.
questions.explanation: Le chauffage ne fonctionne plus dans les salles de réunion.

questions.prompt: What caused the problem?
questions.evidence: A pipe broke in the basement overnight
questions.explanation: Un tuyau a cédé au sous-sol pendant la nuit.

questions.prompt: What does the man offer to do?
questions.evidence: Room 2B is free this afternoon if you'd like me to reserve it for you
questions.explanation: Il propose de réserver la salle 2B, chauffée par un autre système.
questions.takeaway: If you'd like me to… = si vous voulez que je…

audio.t: Hi Sandra, I submitted my expenses from the Madrid trip two weeks ago, but I haven't been reimbursed yet.
Let me look. Your claim is on hold because the hotel receipt is missing.
That's strange. I'm sure I scanned it. Oh wait, I may have attached the restaurant receipt twice.
That would explain it. Just upload the hotel receipt, and I'll process the claim the same day.

questions.prompt: Why is the man contacting the woman?
options: He wants to book a trip.
questions.evidence: I haven't been reimbursed yet
questions.explanation: Il n'a pas encore été remboursé de ses frais de voyage.

questions.prompt: Why is the claim on hold?
questions.evidence: the hotel receipt is missing
questions.explanation: La demande est en suspens car le reçu de l'hôtel manque dans le dossier.

questions.prompt: What does the man realize?
options: He forgot to go to the hotel.
He lost his receipts in Madrid.
He sent his claim to the wrong person.
questions.evidence: I may have attached the restaurant receipt twice
questions.explanation: Il comprend qu'il a joint deux fois le reçu du restaurant au lieu de celui de l'hôtel : il s'est trompé de fichier.
questions.takeaway: « Oh wait » introduit souvent une prise de conscience.

audio.t: I've received four quotes for the staff picnic. Several employees asked for vegetarian dishes this year.
Then that rules out one of them. We also don't have a van to pick up the food, so delivery has to be included.
Right. So it's between two caterers.
Let's go with the cheaper of those two. Can you call them this afternoon to confirm the date?

questions.prompt: What event are the speakers planning?
questions.evidence: I've received four quotes for the staff picnic.
questions.explanation: Ils organisent le pique-nique annuel du personnel.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which caterer will the speakers most likely choose?
questions.explanation: Il faut des plats végétariens (exclut Sunny Grill) et la livraison incluse (exclut Green Fork) ; entre Olive & Co. (21 €) et Basil House (19 €), on prend le moins cher.
questions.traps: Green Fork est moins cher mais la livraison n'est pas incluse.
questions.takeaway: Élimine les options critère par critère.

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask the man to do?
questions.evidence: Can you call them this afternoon to confirm the date?
questions.explanation: Elle lui demande d'appeler le traiteur choisi pour confirmer la date.
questions.takeaway: Confirm the date = confirmer la date.

audio.t: Kenji, do you know if anyone is using the portable projector on Friday? I'm giving a presentation at the Chamber of Commerce.
Marketing borrowed it last week, and I don't think they've returned it.
Oh no. Who should I ask about it?
Talk to Leila. She keeps track of all the equipment. Her office is next to the mailroom.

questions.prompt: What does the woman need on Friday?
questions.evidence: do you know if anyone is using the portable projector on Friday?
questions.explanation: Elle a besoin du projecteur portable pour sa présentation.

questions.prompt: What does the man say about the marketing department?
options: It is moving to a new office.
It organized the Chamber of Commerce event.
It may still have the equipment.
questions.evidence: Marketing borrowed it last week, and I don't think they've returned it.
questions.explanation: Le marketing l'a emprunté et ne l'a probablement pas rendu.

questions.prompt: Who most likely is Leila?
questions.evidence: She keeps track of all the equipment.
questions.explanation: Leila suit l'ensemble du matériel : elle en est responsable.
questions.traps: Son bureau est à côté du service courrier, mais elle n'y travaille pas forcément.
questions.takeaway: Keep track of = suivre, tenir l'inventaire de.

audio.t: Our coffee supplier is raising prices by fifteen percent next month. I've found an alternative, Bean Brothers, that's ten percent cheaper than our current price.
Is their coffee any good, though? People here take their coffee seriously.
We used them at my previous job. The coffee was excellent, but deliveries were sometimes late.
Then let's order a sample pack and run a taste test in the break room before we decide.

questions.prompt: Why is the woman looking for a new supplier?
options: The current coffee quality has dropped.
The current supplier is increasing prices.
questions.evidence: Our coffee supplier is raising prices by fifteen percent next month.
questions.explanation: Le fournisseur actuel augmente ses prix de 15 %.
questions.traps: Les retards de livraison concernent Bean Brothers, pas le fournisseur actuel.

questions.prompt: What concern does the second man raise about Bean Brothers?
options: They do not deliver to offices.
Their products are hard to prepare.
questions.evidence: deliveries were sometimes late
questions.explanation: D'après son expérience, leurs livraisons étaient parfois en retard : un manque de fiabilité.

questions.prompt: What will the speakers do before deciding?
questions.evidence: let's order a sample pack and run a taste test
questions.explanation: Ils commanderont un échantillon pour une dégustation.

audio.t: Hi, I'd like to pick up the glasses I ordered last week. The name's Henrik Olsen.
Let me check. Hmm, they've arrived, but the lenses are slightly scratched. We've already ordered a new pair from the lab.
How long will that take? I'm leaving for a business trip on Thursday.
They usually take three days, but I'll ask the lab to rush the order. I'll call you as soon as they're in.

questions.prompt: Where most likely are the speakers?
questions.evidence: I'd like to pick up the glasses I ordered last week.
questions.explanation: Il vient chercher des lunettes commandées : ils sont chez un opticien.

questions.prompt: What problem does the woman mention?
options: The frames are the wrong color.
questions.evidence: the lenses are slightly scratched
questions.explanation: Les verres sont légèrement rayés : ils sont endommagés.

questions.prompt: What does the woman say she will do?
options: Lend the man a pair of glasses
Mail the glasses to his hotel
questions.evidence: I'll ask the lab to rush the order
questions.explanation: Elle demandera au laboratoire d'accélérer la commande.
questions.takeaway: Rush an order = traiter en urgence.

audio.t: Congratulations on your promotion, Marcus! When do you start as regional manager?
Thanks! Officially on the first of next month, but I'll be training with Ms. Haddad for two weeks before that.
Does that mean you'll be moving to the Bordeaux office?
Not right away. I'll split my time between here and Bordeaux until the end of the year.

questions.prompt: What is the woman congratulating the man on?
questions.evidence: Congratulations on your promotion
questions.explanation: Elle le félicite pour sa promotion au poste de directeur régional.

questions.prompt: What will the man do before he officially starts?
questions.evidence: I'll be training with Ms. Haddad for two weeks before that
questions.explanation: Il se formera auprès de Mme Haddad pendant deux semaines.
questions.takeaway: Train with = être formé par / avec.

questions.prompt: What does the man imply about his move to Bordeaux?
options: It is not part of the new job.
questions.evidence: Not right away.
questions.explanation: « Not right away » : il partagera son temps entre les deux sites jusqu'à la fin de l'année avant de s'y installer.

audio.t: So, what do you think of the space? It used to be a bookstore.
I like the large windows; they'd be perfect for displaying our bicycles. But it's smaller than the photos suggested.
There's also a storage room in the basement that wasn't in the listing. It's about forty square meters.
Oh, that changes things. We could keep our repair workshop down there. Can I see it?

questions.prompt: What type of business does the woman most likely run?
questions.evidence: perfect for displaying our bicycles
questions.explanation: Elle veut exposer « nos vélos » et installer un atelier de réparation : elle tient un magasin de vélos.
questions.traps: Le local était une librairie, mais ce n'est pas son activité.
questions.takeaway: Distingue l'ancien usage du lieu et l'activité de l'interlocutrice.

questions.prompt: What concern does the woman express?
options: The space is smaller than expected.
questions.evidence: it's smaller than the photos suggested
questions.explanation: Le local est plus petit que ce que laissaient penser les photos.

questions.prompt: Why does the woman say, "that changes things"?
options: She is disappointed by the basement.
She wants to lower her offer.
She is now more interested in the space.
She needs to consult her partner.
questions.evidence: Oh, that changes things.
questions.explanation: La réserve en sous-sol pourrait accueillir son atelier : le local devient plus intéressant, et elle demande à la voir.
questions.takeaway: La suite (Can I see it?) confirme l'intérêt.
